item.tib: kun tu bzang po 'khor ba stong bar 'dren pa'i ngan song dong sprug gi rgyud las rnam dag mchod gzhung gi cha lag bsnyen gnas dang snyung gnas kyi cho ga
item.coloph: 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ thugs dgongs bcud byung gdams ngag yin/ nyams su blangs pa'i skyes bu des/ bdag don lhun gyis 'grub pa dang*/ gzhan don mthar phyin 'grub par 'gyur/ dka' thub rnam dag bcud len gyi/ lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig bstan/ dka' thub nyams len bu la spel/ skal med pa la gsang rgya thaM/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
